description_expanded: Description Description 30A ESCAPES presents... “Sunnyside #7,” your next 30A getaway! Located in the Arcadia Community in Seacrest West, this bright retreat offers 3 bedrooms, partial Gulf views from the second-floor balcony and beach access just a 2-minute walk or 1-minute bike ride away. Spend your mornings along the Gulf, relax at the community pool just steps from your door or hop on 4 included bikes to explore 30A's charming shops and restaurants, with The Big Chill entertainment center just a 6-minute ride away. Whether you're spending the afternoon on the beach or exploring nearby coastal communities, “Sunnyside #7” is a wonderful place to settle in and enjoy your stay. Learn more below…👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Nearby Beach Access: Enjoy the sugar-white sands and emerald Gulf waters of 30A with beach access just a 2-minute walk or 1-minute bike ride from the home.Community Pool Nearby: Unwind and soak up the sun by the community pool, conveniently located just steps from your door.Peek-a-Boo Gulf Views: Enjoy beautiful glimpses of the Gulf from your private second-floor balcony.4 Beach Bikes Included: Explore Scenic Highway 30A and its neighboring communities with 4 included bikes.Prime 30A Location: Enjoy convenient access to The Big Chill, Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach for dining, boutique shopping and entertainment.Comfortable Accommodations: Sleeps 8 guests across 3 cozy bedrooms with plenty of room for the whole family.Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐ "Generous towels, loved the upper deck’s ocean view, and appreciated the updates/reminders. Excellent option for relaxation!" – Anonymous⭐ "Absolutely loved the townhouse! Perfect for a girls’ trip. The beds were amazing and the location was unbeatable!" – Suzanne M.⭐ "Spacious with a perfect walk to the beach. Couldn’t ask for more for a family-friendly vacation." – Michael*** LIVING AREA ***Step into a perfect blend of comfort and style in this beautifully designed space. The open-concept living area on the second floor is ideal for both relaxing and entertaining, offering a seamless, inviting flow. Decorated with cozy coastal touches like soft neutral tones, textured furnishings and ocean-inspired accents, it's perfect for unwinding after a day at the beach or exploring 30A. Large windows fill the room with natural light, creating a bright, airy space for family time or gathering with friends.Expansive Living Area: Comfortable seating and a smart TV make this an inviting place to gather for movie nights or relax after a day along the Gulf.Coastal-Inspired Décor: Soft neutral tones, textured furnishings and coastal accents create a comfortable, relaxing atmosphere.Private Second-Floor Balcony: Enjoy partial Gulf views and fresh coastal air from your own outdoor retreat.*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***Elevate your cooking and dining experience! This fully equipped kitchen features modern appliances and high-performance cookware, ensuring meal preparation is both effortless and enjoyable. With ample counter space, a spacious island for prep or casual dining and all the tools you need at your fingertips, it's perfect for preparing meals to share with your group.Fully Equipped Kitchen: Modern kitchen featuring stainless-steel appliances and everything needed for preparing meals throughout your stay.Spacious Dining Accommodations: Dining table comfortably seats 6, with additional seating for 3 at the breakfast bar.Convenient Balcony Access: Step outside with your morning coffee or enjoy an evening cocktail while taking in the coastal surroundings.*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***With three comfortable bedrooms spread across two floors, “Sunnyside #7” offers plenty of room for families and groups to settle in. Two King bedrooms on the first floor provide comfortable retreats, while the upstairs bunk room is a great space for younger guests. With three bathrooms throughout the home, everyone has room to get ready for a day at the beach or unwind after exploring 30A.1st FloorPrimary King Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV, porch access and En-suite with dual vanities & shower/tub comboKing Guest Suite: King bed and flat-screen TVGuest Bathroom: Single vanity and shower/tub combo2nd FloorBunk Room: 2 Twin-over-Twin bunks, flat-screen TV and En-suite with single vanity & walk-in shower*** OUTDOOR & COMMUNITY AMENITIES ***Enjoy the relaxed atmosphere of Arcadia Community, where the neighborhood pool is just steps from “Sunnyside #7” and the beach is only a 2-minute walk or 1-minute bike ride away. Spend a sunny afternoon lounging poolside, head down to the Gulf for a day on the sand or enjoy your morning coffee on the private balcony overlooking the coastal surroundings. With 4 bikes included, exploring the shops, restaurants and neighboring communities along 30A is easy.Nearby Beach Access: Just a 2-minute walk or 1-minute bike ride from the home, making it easy to enjoy the beautiful beaches of 30A throughout your stay.Community Pool: Located just steps from the home, complete with lounge chairs for relaxing in the Florida sunshine.Private Second-Floor Balcony: Enjoy partial Gulf views, fresh coastal air and a comfortable place to unwind outdoors.4 Beach Bikes Included: Explore Scenic Highway 30A and the surrounding coastal communities at your own pace.*** NEARBY ATTRACTIONS ***Located in Seacrest West, “Sunnyside #7” puts you close to the beautiful beaches of 30A and some of the area's most popular communities and local favorites. Spend the morning enjoying the Gulf before heading out to discover the beautiful architecture of Alys Beach, browse the boutiques of Rosemary Beach or explore the shops and restaurants at The Big Chill. From casual afternoons shopping to evenings enjoying local dining and entertainment, there's plenty to experience throughout the area.The Big Chill: A popular entertainment destination featuring live music, diverse restaurants and unique shopping experiences.Alys Beach: Known for its iconic white architecture, beautiful surroundings and exceptional dining.Rosemary Beach: Explore charming streets, boutique shops, cafés and wonderful local restaurants.Seaside: Discover colorful cottages, outdoor markets, local shops and a laid-back coastal atmosphere.*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included but can be purchased separately.We DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment.Parking available for 2 vehiclesWaiver required to get access to the 4 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes.LSV (Low Speed Vehicles) are NOT allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest, or Alys Beach.*** YOUR STAY – OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 guest support and an immaculate home designed for comfort, connection, and coastal charm.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 210504STRO #: STR-210504 Read less
